_comment: Kernel machine authority for worker context profiles and global launch budgets. Read by the verifier's stdlib json (src/verify-agent-docs.sh). Field values are byte-faithful to the legacy context-profiles.md '## Profiles' table the kernel supersedes; core_rule_paths/overlays keep their inline backtick markup so the resolved rows are identical to the prior awk-parsed output. This is the SOLE authority for these facts after the Wave 1b cutover - no profile field or budget number lives in both here and Markdown/bash.

profiles.purpose: fixed first /orchestrate phase: investigate and return the workflow-brief that resolves classification

profiles.overlays: authoring rules when plan edits touch durable docs

source/tests selected by task; `src/rules/coding-style-rust.md` when task is Rust; `src/rules/coding-style-python.md` when task is Python; `src/rules/coding-style-frontend.md` when task is frontend/TS

manifest and ownership rows for touched surfaces; `src/rules/coding-style-rust.md` when task is Rust; `src/rules/coding-style-python.md` when task is Python; `src/rules/coding-style-frontend.md` when task is frontend/TS

profiles.purpose: selected tracked-plan implementation and closeout; may close the selected plan when dispatch grants `plan_closeout
profiles.overlays: selected plans and owning architecture/decisions; `src/rules/coding-style-rust.md` when task is Rust; `src/rules/coding-style-python.md` when task is Python; `src/rules/coding-style-frontend.md` when task is frontend/TS
manifest and ownership rows for touched docs
selected plans/run docs and owning docs
manifest drift-gates and named command output

profiles.purpose: read-only doc drift/shape inspection: report findings against code and the authoring rules, never edit
profiles.overlays: named docs and ownership rows for the checked surfaces

profiles.purpose: read-only plan-health inspection: report lifecycle/staleness/migration findings, never edit
